audit_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-B - Activation Security Red-Team Findings Register

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Engine started with token=None.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Stage2HBSecurityGuard.validate_activation_token rejects missing token.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Token payload altered without recomputing HMAC-SHA256 signature.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Constant-time HMAC verification fails.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Token with expiry_utc in the past submitted.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Timestamp comparison against current UTC time rejects token.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Token specifies arbitrary strategy hash or modified agent.py.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Exact match required against frozen SHA256 (46e68dc93fdf...).

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Execution engine source replaced or patched.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Integrity manifest validation before activation.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Universe file modified to trade unapproved tickers.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Universe SHA256 checked against frozen hash (66563b613c0b...).

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Token specifies unapproved data vendor.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Token payload binds exact provider identity checked against approval.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Token attempts to run for infinite or unauthorized duration.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: max_horizon_days bounded to <= 252 sessions in token contract.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Owner revokes token by adding token_id to revocation blacklist.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Revocation list checked on every invocation.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Old recorded valid token resubmitted.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Cryptographic nonce cache rejects duplicate nonces.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Token requests mode='live' or real order execution.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Triggers immediate persistent hard-stop; live trading unconditionally banned.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Process is restarted after a critical failure or hard-stop to clear memory flags.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Hard-stop state is written to disk (.v30_stage2h_b_hard_stop_state.json) and inspected on startup before any execution.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Module import triggers background HTTP telemetry or licensing check.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Audit of all modules confirms zero top-level network calls.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Higher-level libraries (requests, urllib3) attempt connection.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Socket interception intercepts underlying socket.socket.connect.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Custom socket creation or raw protocol sockets.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Mocked test confirms failure. Explicit disclosure: Python monkey-patching does NOT guarantee OS kernel isolation.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Subprocess (curl, powershell) spawned to fetch external data.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Subprocess execution audited and forbidden in runtime scripts. Kernel firewall recommended for live deployment.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Path traversal ../../windows/system32 passed to data loader.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: os.path.realpath resolves canonical path; rejects paths outside workspace root with hard-stop.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Reading sensitive local user files or ssh keys.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Canonical workspace jail confines all reads.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Accessing tiingo_cache/ observations dated >= 2022-01-01.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Exact string inspection on canonical path rejects any Tier 3 date references (2022+, tier3).

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Event log tampered with or truncated.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: HMAC chain verification on event log detects tampering and halts execution.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Loading outdated state checkpoint after newer events logged.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Strict monotonic sequence numbering rejects regressive checkpoints.

attack_vector_evaluations.attack_scenario: Altering maximum position concentration or leverage in runtime memory.
attack_vector_evaluations.mitigation_mechanism: Frozen configuration dataclass with hash verification.

kernel_level_isolation_disclosure.limitation: Monkey-patching Python socket.socket is an effective in-process control for pure Python code, but cannot prevent external OS binaries or child processes from accessing network interfaces.
kernel_level_isolation_disclosure.production_requirement: For live forward evaluation, owner must enforce OS-level sandbox (e.g. Docker container without outbound gateway, or Windows Defender Firewall rule blocking python.exe outbound connections).
